uphill_grade_metrics.note: Positive uphill grade only; ORS elevation coordinates resampled by route distance and median-smoothed. This is a terrain estimate, not a field slope survey.

crossing_metrics.data_status: OSM mapped records only; missing or unmapped crossings are unknown, not absent.

network_metrics.walkability_score_note: Only mapped OSM ways are classified; unmatched portions remain unknown and are not treated as unsafe.

running_fitness.classification_status: OSM tag estimate only; not field-verified running quality or safety.
running_fitness.vehicle_separation_note: OSM highway class is a separation proxy; physical barriers, traffic conditions and actual use were not verified.
running_fitness.continuous_running_note: Longest mapped running-friendly stretch between OSM-mapped crossing/signal interruptions; unmapped interruptions may be missing.
running_fitness.cycleway_note: Cycleways without foot=yes/designated/permissive are excluded from walkable running share and reported as uncertain.

access_connections.status: ORS route geometry snap distance; confirms routing-network attachment only, not a physical open entrance.

turn_metrics.turn_measurement_note: ORS geometry heading changes over adjacent segments >=5m; mapped road junction identity is not available.

cross_mode_selection.reason: 기존 모드 1순위와 70% 이상 겹쳐, 거리 허용 조건을 지키면서 점수 하락 10점 이내·도로 공유율 70% 미만인 대안을 우선 배치했습니다.

running_analysis.reason: 거리 오차 34m; 출발 300m 내 OSM 매핑 횡단 0회, 전체 매핑 횡단 14회; 경사 점수 50.7/100, 상승 122.9m; 급경사 구간 21.8%; 반복 구간 0.0%, 급회전 추정 22회, U턴 추정 0회
